facts.fact: The NCRA has been migrating its enrolled identity records to the MOSIP platform since completing a pilot in early 2024, according to its Deputy Director.
Sierra Leone has an existing identity system that stakeholders already use for service delivery and which MOSIP is replacing, according to the NCRA Deputy Director.
NIRA completed the migration of more than 28 million records to its new MOSIP-based identity platform and added about 6.7 million new registrations, issuing new IDs.

facts.fact: NIRA deduplicated multiple biometric databases during the migration and found about 200,000 duplicates over about seven months.
